_comment: Copy to local.json (git-ignored) to run test_local.py against your own router. cfg: same keys as /etc/noobrouter-agent.json. iptables_save: path relative to agent/tests; put it under fixtures/local/ (git-ignored), e.g. ssh root@<router> iptables-save > agent/tests/fixtures/local/iptables_save.txt. expect: optional counts to assert.
